metadata.description: QAuth's flow, UI, domain and navigation graphs in delurio-graph/0 (ADR-021, graphs/README.md). It holds no code: nothing can import it, so it needs no scope tag and no lint boundary, and nothing in apps/ or libs/ depends on delurio. Its targets only run delurio's pinned CLI (@delurio/cli, a root devDependency) over this directory.

Run delurio's `check --strict` over every graph directory under graphs/ (each directory that holds a flow.yaml or a nav.yaml). It reads graph files only: no server, no database, no network. Findings are GNU error lines, `<file>:<line>:<column>: error: <message> [<rule id>]`. Exit 0 clean, 1 a graph cannot be loaded, 2 a finding under --strict. Cached on graphs/** and the pinned delurio version. CI runs it from #568.
